_readme: Last Harvest prices, in scrap. Change a number, save this file, then reload the game (F5).
Use whole numbers. Buildings and upgrades have one price per level; levels a farm starts with are not listed.
If something here is wrong, the game keeps its built-in price for it and the title screen says what to fix.
After changing prices, run  node balance-sim.mjs  in the game folder: a bot plays 12 farms with these prices.

shop._what: Supply store, per purchase: ammo = 12 shells, seeds = 6 seeds, heal = 35 health for one person, repair = 35 farmhouse health, cow = one cow for the pasture.

buildings._what: Each level is bought separately. waterTank = water tank, coop = chicken coop, market = market stall, doghouse = dog house.

upgrades._what: Farm upgrades. weapons needs blueprints from an expedition first.

defenses._what: Per piece placed. fenceRepair = mending one damaged fence section.
